name: Turn The Other Cheek
overview: Scripture teaches believers to respond to personal offenses with grace and non-retaliation, as Jesus instructs in Matthew 5:39 and Luke 6:29 to 'turn the other cheek' rather than seeking vengeance. This principle contrasts with the Old Testament law of 'an eye for an eye' (Matthew 5:38) and calls for trusting God's justice, as Romans 12:19 reminds us that vengeance belongs to the Lord. While Jesus acknowledges practical preparation for trials (Luke 22:36), the heart of His teaching is to resist evil not with retaliation but with humble, Christlike forgiveness.
